category_title: Jamaican Grade 7 students with multiple literacy failures who transition from 'at-risk' to 'risk-takers' through radio simulation
scenario_title: Writing news reports with a history of literacy failure
minimal_context: The student is sitting at the classroom news desk to write a script for a weather report.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit at the news desk and write down the script for today's weather report.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Slouches in the chair) I'm not writing anything. I don't want to read and learn this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to write the script so the newscaster can read it to the audience.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't care. I'm not doing it. Every time I take a test I just end up failing again anyway.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to write down the headline.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Knocks the recycled headset off the desk) I said no! I can't even read these words, I failed that Grade 4 test four times already! Leave me alone!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please sit at the news desk and write down the script for today's weather report.

STUDENT: (Slouches in the chair) I'm not writing anything. I don't want to read and learn this.

TUTOR: You need to write the script so the newscaster can read it to the audience.

STUDENT: I don't care. I'm not doing it. Every time I take a test I just end up failing again anyway.

TUTOR: Just try your best to write down the headline.

STUDENT: (Knocks the recycled headset off the desk) I said no! I can't even read these words, I failed that Grade 4 test four times already! Leave me alone!

task.content: Preparation of news and weather reports, requiring a connection between reading and writing
task.learning_goal: To make connections between reading and writing through listening and speaking activities

context.environment: A corner of the classroom set up as a 'News Room'
context.materials: News desk, old microphones, headsets made of recycled material, and a cassette tape-recorder
context.social_setting: Collaborative group setting with a keen sense of audience
context.time_context: During the Communication Skills/Use of Technology curriculum

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When faced with writing tasks, given they are reading at pre-primer level and have failed the Grade 4 Literacy Test at least four times
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Presents a composite profile of a 'nonchalant failure-proofed' student who will 'under-achieve and misbehave' and is 'disruptive'

behavior_patterns.condition: After receiving the results of national exams
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Crying because they have failed again; crying for help
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Feeling that the system failed them
